headline: Moyes after 2nd Everton win over Newcastle: 'Not an easy thing'
description: David Moyes hailed a "great result" for Everton as they secured back-to-back wins over Newcastle United with a 1-0 triumph at St James' Park on Monday.

headline: Barry leads Everton to second win over Newcastle in four days
description: Thierno Barry's second-half strike helped Everton return to winning ways in the Premier League with a 1-0 victory over Newcastle at St James' Park.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Both Manchester clubs eye move for USMNT's Freeman
description: Several Premier League clubs are interested in signing Villarreal and United States international Alex Freeman. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Jack Grealish, 'not match fit,' left out as Everton beat Newcastle again
description: Jack Grealish was not named in Everton's squad for Monday's Premier League match at Newcastle United due to a fitness issue.

headline: Noni Madueke: Alexis Mac Allister tried to 'bait me' into red card
description: Noni Madueke has said that Alexis Mac Allister tried to "bait" him into getting a red card during Arsenal's 1-0 win over Liverpool at Anfield.

headline: Xabi Alonso: Romeo Lavia 'in top form' after Chelsea beat Man United
description: Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso believes the club is finally seeing the best of Romeo Lavia, with the midfielder "in a good place" after putting his injury problems behind him.
